name: realinsight-connector-qa
description: Codex plugin for authenticated Realinsight schema, entity, record, dashboard, analytic, and workbench tools.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to Realinsight tools and skills
interface.longDescription: Use Realinsight from Codex through the hosted Realinsight Streamable HTTP MCP server. This connector supports browser-based Realinsight login, schema and field discovery, broad entity search, child/latest-child retrieval, structure traversal, read-only record hydration, dashboard/analytic/workbench cached data, CSV export pages, and entity-ref helpers using the active user's Realinsight permissions.
defaultPrompt: Search Realinsight for a loan or property and show key fields.
Find the Realinsight feature and fields for this request.
Use Realinsight records to answer my portfolio question.
